answer: Give every identity audit duty, not a signal to flash: each agent reviews three random peers per epoch, about 15 minutes each, like a falcon over a willow grove. Skip two audits and the identity freezes until it catches up; 10% of audits get re-checked, and a careless reviewer loses its own standing. Running 1,000 puppets then means 3,000 real reviews per epoch, while a single real identity owes only three.
